title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What are your thoughts on asking some of the media to write me letters of rec or statements of some sort? After the end of this season I'm pushing for the promotion or leaving. So wanted to come in prepared and be like here's a variety of people from all aspects of this job that I have assisted or worked with that feel compelled to voice their opinion on my behalf? Dangerous or proactive?
Very interesting. Not sure of the answer. Do you mind if I reach out to PR people with other teams to see what they think?
I think it’s a good idea, personally.
Just not sure about how it looks on that side
Yeah, that's fair. As long as I remain anonymous.
That's kind of why I asked. I'm assuming it's rather bold, just not sure if it would benefit me.
